state_features.suggestion_scope: Regions and neighbor anchors are observations only. They do not restrict node choice, displacement, or grouping. Generate your own coordinated gate moves/swaps and edge order.
state_features.route_path_encoding: Exact rectilinear bend points; route_costs contain unit-step costs.

incumbent_port_envelope.scope: Current PI/PO XY envelope only; movable ports mean this is NOT an area lower bound.

rules.port_coordinate_scope: PI/PO node XY may move; identities remain fixed.
rules.objective: Reduce actual routed bounding area and exported QCA cells; both non-increasing, one strictly improved. Distinguish node-box proxy from actual routed area.
rules.routing_execution: The supplied complete routing_order is executed once by A*, with no order fallback. A failed candidate consumes the evaluation and returns diagnostics.
rules.search_contract: Return ifcn.layout_search.v2 with your own operations, a complete unique routing_order, and a concise observable rationale. Keep all logical identities and edges, including every PI/PO identity, fixed. PI/PO XY may move. At least one true internal node must change XY; port-only compaction and routing-only proposals are excluded in this experiment. Logical layers are dependencies, not fixed physical rows. Use independent X/Y internal moves or swaps and choose a complete routing order. Every exact proposal is rerouted, assigned clocks, mapped to QCA and independently certified. Retained best changes only on actual area/cell Pareto improvement. A separate fully certified exploration state can temporarily increase area and cells by at most 10% relative to the retained best, to cross a local plateau. A failed route is not evidence that the whole region is exhausted.
rules.proposal_contract: Directly choose internal-gate XY moves or swaps and the complete routing order. At least one internal gate must move. There is no candidate-ID menu. You may coordinate internal and port moves only when port_coordinates_movable=true. One exact proposal is executed per round; failed moves return diagnostics for the next round.

proposal.rationale: Axis y cut at 23: translate the suffix by -2 tile(s). Gate bounding-box proxy only; rerouting and DRC have not been evaluated.
Axis y cut at 26: translate the suffix by -2 tile(s). Gate bounding-box proxy only; rerouting and DRC have not been evaluated.

feedback_scope: At most 12 actual past evaluations from the last four rounds; positive metric deltas mean worse.
